top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a mature, independently confirmed discovery: the Kane-Mele Z2 invariant and quantum spin Hall state in a time-reversal-invariant spin-orbit insulator, with its first experimental observation as quantised helical edge conductance in Molenkamp's HgTe quantum wells. This is a distinct class of matter from the 2016 topological-phase prize, and the narrow citation, tied to the 2D state, avoids implying credit for the 3D materials work. The three names match the theory-plus-first-experiment structure, although the omission of Hasan and of Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang is a real cost. P002 (optical lattice clock, Katori and Ye) is a clean, mature two-name invention and ranks second; its increment over the 2005 and 2012 prizes is plausible but I cannot test it independently. Awarding a prize is better than no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented connection to Kane, Mele, Molenkamp, Katori or Ye (my astroparticle collaborations PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, PoGOLite/PoGO+ and XL-Calibur are unrelated to the proposed parts)
